h1: Amazon Product Photos for the Main Image and the Gallery
lead: From one photo you already have, make the Amazon main image, a detail, and an in-use view, then repeat that across the catalog. A batch, or your own tools, can use that same setup.
card: Amazon listing photos from one product photo: main, detail and in-use.

faq.q: What does Amazon expect on the main image?
faq.a: The main frame is the plain product on white, large enough to fill the square. Keep a badge or a prop for a later image, and read the current line in Seller Central before you publish.

faq.q: What if a photo breaks those rules?
faq.a: A cluttered main photo can keep the listing out of search until you swap that file. A prop can sit on a later image. The first image is the strict one.

faq.q: How do I get a white main image from a normal photo?
faq.a: Choose the white main on a photo you already have. The old background is gone in that file, and you can follow the steps in [Amazon white background photo](/guides/white-background-amazon).

faq.q: Can I prepare many Amazon photos in one run?
faq.a: Yes. Send the whole line through together, lifestyle frames included. Each file spends credits, the cost shows first, and a failed job returns those credits.

faq.q: Can my own software prepare the Amazon images?
faq.a: Yes. When a new product is saved in your catalog tool, that tool can request the image. You choose the moment it goes into Seller Central, and we never sign in to the seller account.

faq.q: What other images should I add to an Amazon listing?
faq.a: A close-up, a sense of size, and the item in use. Each one answers the next question a shopper has.

faq.q: Can I put words on the pictures?
faq.a: Add the words yourself after download, and only on images after the main one. The main image stays free of badges and slogans.

faq.q: Can I make a video for the listing?
faq.a: Yes. A video is its own job at 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds, costing 24, 40, 60, or 120 credits.

faq.q: Will you upload the photos into Amazon for me?
faq.a: No. Download the files and add them in Seller Central yourself. We do not connect to your seller login.

reasons.h2: Amazon Product Images Without a Photo Setup
reasons.lead: You can start an Amazon listing photo from the upload, instead of standing up your own image setup.

items.d: You upload the product and get label-color variants before the listing goes up. Nobody has to wire a model or a review queue first.

Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600. A photo spends 24 credits. You do not buy a training set, and you do not keep a GPU rack warm in the off months.
When cutouts get cleaner, your next Amazon image gets the better version. There is nothing to install or update on your side.
In a peak week you can refresh a whole run of products in one sitting, and the run finishes. You are not watching a homemade queue stall while the rest of the catalog waits.
The product sits the same distance from the edge on Amazon and on your own site. When the picture rule changes, you adjust that one setup instead of redrawing every file.
